description.value: El Furniture Warehouse is a casual pub-style restaurant on Whistler's Main Street, part of the multi-location Warehouse Group chain with outposts across Canada. It serves a broad menu of burgers, wings, nachos, poutine, salads, and signature cocktails in a laid-back setting with outdoor patio seating. Centrally located just a short walk from Whistler Village, it draws locals and visitors alike looking for a filling, unpretentious meal after a day of mountain adventure.
